items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I knew Eddie. ... everybody's always wanted him. ... it was well received by me

ctx.x: And it just reeked of money, you know?

Little, little prince. He's a little prince. I've always, I, I could just call him the little prince. I think that he, uh, Eddie's fine, and he, he's always liked and everybody ever, in recording sessions, everybody's always wanted him. Mm-hmm.
When he left the shop, though, this, the other fellow up there in the shop looks over and says, who was that?
